messages:
ashley: Promo held — staging->prod canary failed. deploy-bot shows 2/3 canaries passed, canary-3 stuck at runner-cache-verify.

``deploy-bot: [status] canary-3 failed: job_id=468234, step=runner-cache-verify, exit=1. logs: "cache index mismatch: expected e5f2, got 91a3". https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/468234``

jordan: :eyes: is this the runner that had repeated evictions yesterday?

pat: Looks like cache index drift. Quick triage: can we invalidate the runner cache and requeue the job on a different runner? e.g.

```
cictl invalidate-cache --runner=runner-09
ci-bot rerun-job 468234 --fresh-runner
```

sam: I can take runner-09. Will check node evictions, OOMs and kubelet events.

ashley: If rerun passes, i'm ok with manual promote. If rerun fails, propose pinning to last-good artifact digest and re-running canary set.

jordan: what's last-good digest? can we promote that fast?

pat: last-good: sha256:7f4c2d. Pin command:

```
deployctl set-image service/frontend@sha256:7f4c2d --env=prod
```

ci-bot: Rerun requested: job_id=468234 scheduled on fresh runner. ETA ~3m.

ashley: ok pat, you coordinate pin if rerun fails. sam/jordan monitor infra. i'll update release notes / change window slack channel: link to changelog draft https://docs.redwood/release/694

sam: runner-09 had a kubelet eviction 10m ago, clearing cache now.

deploy-bot: job 468234 rerun started on runner-12.

jordan: quick thumbs — if rerun passes, manual promote approved by on-call. :thumbsup:

pat: noted — will prepare pin AND a rollback playbook in case pin has regressions.

ashley: decision: wait for rerun. if pass -> manual promote at +10m; if fail -> pin to sha256:7f4c2d and schedule a canary re-roll at +30m. all good?

sam: yep. monitoring logs and will post updates.

deploy-bot: job 468234 completed: status=PASS. archiving logs.

ashley: going to trigger manual promote now.

deploy-bot: promote started by ashley. canary promotion complete, cut release v1.42.3

ashley: release notes updated: include note about temporary cache inconsistency and that infra patched runner-09; follow-up ops ticket created: #OPS-984

jordan: nice, closing loop. :tada:
